name: Curriculum-Attack TRADES + AWP
tagline: TRADES with confidence-weighted KL, KL-then-CE attack curriculum, and a one-step AWP weight perturbation around the loss.

key_hyperparams.name: attack switch
key_hyperparams.role: step at which KL attack switches to CE attack

diff_from_baseline: Adds two pieces on top of TRADES+AWP: (a) the PGD attack uses KL maximization for the first K/2 steps then CE for the remaining steps (curriculum), and (b) the KL term is weighted by 1+0.5(1−p_y) so misclassified samples get larger consistency pressure. AWP is a simplified one-step gradient ascent on the actual loss (not a separate proxy model as in the AWP baseline).

name: Confidence-Adaptive TRADES (CAR)
tagline: Per-sample weight from clean confidence interpolates between KL consistency and adversarial CE, on top of vanilla TRADES.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces TRADES' uniform β·KL with a per-sample weighted KL plus a complementary (1−w_i)-weighted adversarial CE term. Confident samples are pushed toward boundary smoothness; under-confident samples receive PGDAT-style adversarial supervision. Attack still maximizes KL like TRADES.

name: TRADES + Adaptive Adv-CE + Layer AWP
tagline: AWP perturbation derived from a KL-only objective, then optimization on TRADES loss plus a confidence-weighted adversarial CE term.
init_recovers: TRADES when γ_AWP=0 and the (1−p_c,y) Adv-CE is dropped
diff_from_baseline: AWP is computed in-place on the live model from the KL-only gradient (skipping the proxy model and the −(CE+βKL) objective the AWP baseline uses). The outer loss adds an adversarial cross-entropy term weighted by (1−clean confidence), so hard examples get extra direct adversarial supervision compared to plain TRADES.

name: Adaptive Anchor-Margin AT (AAMAT)
tagline: PGD attack on CE+margin softplus; outer loss anchors adv predictions to a confidence-mixed soft target plus margin penalty, weighted by hardness.

key_hyperparams.name: τ schedule
key_hyperparams.role: label-smoothing strength tied to clean confidence

init_recovers: Roughly PGDAT when τ=0, w=1, γ=0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the simple PGDAT/TRADES targets with: (a) attack maximizes CE plus a margin-softplus, (b) adv loss uses an anchor target that interpolates one-hot with the clean predictive distribution (more smoothing for confident samples), (c) explicit margin-softplus penalty added, and (d) every adv term is reweighted by a hardness/boundary score. No KL, no AWP.

name: Robust Focal TRADES (RFT)
tagline: TRADES KL plus adversarial CE, both reweighted by an adversarial-confidence focal factor (1 - p_adv,y)^γ.
diff_from_baseline: Adds an explicit adversarial CE term to TRADES and reweights both adversarial CE and the KL term by the focal factor (1−p_adv,y)^γ. Compared to MART, the focal weight uses adversarial (not clean) confidence, so emphasis tracks current adversarial vulnerability.
